description: Defines a standard XSS filter class for Drupal's editor module, implementing filtering logic to sanitize HTML content by removing dangerous tags and attributes, with special handling for data attributes.

classes.name: Standard
classes.description: A class implementing a standard XSS filter for Drupal's editor module, extending the Xss class and implementing EditorXssFilterInterface.

methods.name: filterXss
methods.description: Filters HTML content to remove dangerous tags and attributes, respecting format restrictions and handling data attributes.

methods.name: filterXssDataAttributes
methods.description: Permissively filters data-attributes within HTML to prevent XSS attacks.

methods.name: getAllowedTags
methods.description: Extracts allowed HTML tags from a restrictions data structure.

methods.name: needsRemoval
methods.description: Determines if an HTML element needs removal based on tags, overriding parent behavior.
